title: sms_client.form_encode duplicates stripe_client.form_encode without sharing the +→%2B fix
evidence: sms_client.gleam:306 `fn form_encode(params: List(#(String, String))) -> String {` and 314-315 `fn encode_form_value(value: String) -> String {` / `  uri.percent_encode(value) |> string.replace("+", "%2B")`. stripe_client.gleam:609 `fn form_encode(params: List(#(String, String))) -> String {` and 612 `    uri.percent_encode(pair.0) <> "=" <> uri.percent_encode(pair.1)` (no + re-encode).
detail: Identical-shaped private form encoder now lives in two modules. sms_client's adds the +→%2B re-encode E.164 numbers need; stripe_client's lacks it (latent, per spec its values rarely carry +).
recommended_fix: Extract a shared form_encode (with the +→%2B fix) into a small http util both clients import; removes the fork and closes stripe_client's latent + gap in one move.
